author: sam Zheng
why: 4160 × 6240 portrait, photographed with a Canon DSLR. Tower and traditional pagoda create a recognisable Nanjing composition; foreground buildings obscure the tower's base.

author: Cheng Shi Song
why: 3833 × 5021, close to 3:4. Nikon photograph with green foliage framing the skyline; useful contextual alternative, though the tower is more distant and its base obscured.

author: James Steinkamp Photography
why: Lead professional photograph in the architect's Zifeng Tower gallery. Explicit photographic credit supports provenance; source states copyright but no reuse licence. Pixel dimensions unverified.

author: 蓉 王
why: Vertical architectural view focused on Zifeng Tower. Recognisable silhouette, with softer colour under an overcast sky; original dimensions unverified.
